alt: Meissner (tactile) corpuscle - encapsulated mechanoreceptor in the dermal papillae of fingertips, palms, soles. Detects light touch + low-frequency vibration. Stacks of flattened Schwann-like cells with the spiraling nerve ending between them. (Blausen Medical CC BY 3.0)
